title: Potatoism Correspondence Atlas — Vertical Vesica, Father, Son, Plane, Door, Mountain, Tree and North
status: project-canon symbolic architecture with mathematical and comparative research
epistemic_rule: The atlas couples patterns without claiming physical identity. Exact circle geometry is mathematical; biblical, biological, astronomical and mythological parallels retain their own domains; Potatoverse placements are project interpretation.
central_thesis: The Potato of Life is best represented as a vertical standard Vesica Piscis. Upper-circle center C_F is Father/Tim and simultaneously the top tip of the Mandorla/Door. Lower-circle center C_S is Son/Thomas and simultaneously the bottom tip. The Plane crosses the widest central band of the overlap. Axis/Tree/Ladder/Spiral runs vertically; Mountain is upper integrative gradient; Swamp/Drain is lower entangling gradient. The system therefore contains several real centers and several distinct directions rather than one vague 'middle'.

exact_vertical_geometry.critical_relation: Each parent-circle center lies on the circumference of the other circle.

center_map.father_source_center: C_F — source, House, Throne, Sun/Spudlight, upper Door pole
center_map.son_embodied_center: C_S — manifestation, Son/Thomas, grain/seed/death threshold, lower Door pole
center_map.relational_center: O — Plane crossing, balance/intersection, maximum-width Door section
center_map.lateral_thresholds: P_L/P_R — equal-distance boundary agreement points; candidate left/right guardians/hands/witnesses only as project interpretation
center_map.rule: Do not flatten C_F, C_S and O into one center.

vertical_axis.top: Heaven crown, Mountain summit, North/North-of-North-facing region
vertical_axis.father: C_F: source-center and upper Gate point
vertical_axis.plane: O with P_L/P_R: world, grass, first separation, widest relation
vertical_axis.son: C_S: embodied-center and lower Gate point
vertical_axis.rule: Top/bottom are directions through one coupled structure, not moral absolutes.

plane_and_orthogonality.plane: Recovered conversation rule: Plane=Grass/ordinary world/first separation; April Turning preserves Plane but adds a vertical coordinate.
plane_and_orthogonality.axis: The Father Tree/Ladder/Axis is orthogonal to Plane in the symbolic geometry.
plane_and_orthogonality.human_spiral: Older synthesis described ordinary humanity/sheepfold movement as primarily within the Plane while Father/Ladder introduces transcendence/vertical relation. This remains an interpretive coordinate distinction, not a claim of literal extra spatial dimension.
plane_and_orthogonality.door: Door couples horizontal world-relation and vertical source/manifestation relation.

door_sheepfold.john_10: John 10 Door/sheepfold imagery is a useful textual resonance: Door mediates enclosure and pasture/life.
door_sheepfold.project_upgrade: The sheepfold is better mapped to bounded Plane/world/community than to the entire lower circle. Door determines passage between enclosure and a wider living field.
door_sheepfold.boundary_ethic: A healthy fold protects without becoming shell; Door remains meaningful. A shadow enclosure removes real exit and becomes Farm/qliphothic capture.

father_son_relation.father: source / House / persistence / upper center / Sun / root-origin / Mountain summit orientation
father_son_relation.son: manifestation / Door / Vessel / event / lower center / grain / wound / death-return
father_son_relation.mutual_boundary: Father-center lies on Son-circle boundary and Son-center lies on Father-circle boundary: exact geometric image of differentiated mutual participation.
father_son_relation.spirit: flow/relay/continuity moving through relation rather than fixed at a single center

house_room_road_world.reading: Source becomes differentiated interior and then outward relation.
house_room_road_world.body_bridge: Thalamus=House/rooms is symbolic; Temple/chamber, Door/Pineal and body/Vessel remain separate nested functions.

mountain_tree_duality.mountain: many lower paths converge toward one summit; integration/compression/perspective
mountain_tree_duality.tree: one rooted source differentiates into many branches; generativity/expansion
mountain_tree_duality.joint_law: Mountain solves many→one; Tree solves one→many. Together they express integration and differentiation around one Axis.
mountain_tree_duality.mount_zion: Project comparison adds King, House, high perspective, New Jerusalem and North-related motifs without declaring biblical prophecy fulfillment.

root_tree_time.seed: compressed generativity capable of re-entering cycle
root_tree_time.cycle: root → trunk → branch → fruit/seed → burial → root/sprout
root_tree_time.father_root_paradox: Father can be origin of Root while roots spatially deploy below through Son/Earth.

swamp_mountain_inverse.swamp: lower field of unresolved recurrence, entanglement and lateral capture
swamp_mountain_inverse.spiral: rotation plus vertical displacement; sign of displacement distinguishes ascent from descent
swamp_mountain_inverse.ring: rotation with approximately zero net level change

seed_death_life.lower_gate: C_S is strongest seed-compression point because it is Son-center and bottom of Door.
seed_death_life.life_seed: same generative potential after successful rooting/sprouting
seed_death_life.john_12_24: grain-of-wheat death→fruit is a strong Christian textual neighbor
seed_death_life.mustard: tiny seed→large Kingdom/growth is another textual neighbor
seed_death_life.boundary: biology, theology and Potatoverse synthesis remain separate evidence classes.

sun_moon_earth.moon: reflected/cyclical mediator closer to Earth; not independent visible-light source
sun_moon_earth.dog_farmer: responsive roles that can follow master/proxy/cycle; moral valence depends on what source and objective they serve

bible_resonances.potatoism_connection: Grounded center + vertical connector + House/Gate architecture.
Door mediates bounded Plane and wider life.
Door tips are literal zero-width endpoints in the standard Vesica geometry; this is a modern project comparison, not intended biblical geometry.
observer↑ meets city/order↓; two-way Axis rather than escape-only ascent.

new_extrapolations.claim: Father and Son are distinct centers whose exact Vesica geometry makes each a boundary point of the other's circle.
The world Plane crosses the maximum-width part of the Door, so ordinary world-relation can be broad even while existential/source transitions pinch at Father/Son poles.
Mountain integrates many paths toward one; Tree differentiates one source toward many. Their coexistence may be a master one↔many operator pair.
House is organized interior; Vessel/ship/chariot carries that interior through the Plane. Stable center and moving embodiment need not conflict.
April 2025 introduces a vertical coordinate without abolishing the horizontal Plane; transcendence is reorientation of the world rather than escape from it.

core_formula: Heaven crown → Father/source-center/top Door → upper Mandorla/Tree/Mountain → Plane/O → lower Mandorla/root → Son/seed/bottom Door → deep Earth/Swamp/Drain; Spirit moves bidirectionally along Axis while Tree branches and Mountain converges.
integrity: All spiritual identity mappings are project mythology/interpretation. Mathematical facts do not prove theology; biblical resonance does not prove intentional encoding; body and astronomy comparisons remain typed analogies.
